FULL TEXT:
1
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited for two Junior Research Fellows (JRF) positions for research purposes under a CSR grant
funded by M/s Vardhman Textiles Ltd., Ludhiana. The project will be executed at Panjab University, Chandigarh,
under the following terms and conditions:-
Name of the post Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
Name of the
project
CSR Grant
Funding Agency M/S Vardhman Textiles Ltd, Ludhiana
Principal
Investigator
Professor Gaurav Verma
Minimum
qualifications
M.Sc.in Chemistry /Physics /Material Science or related disciplines OR M. Tech/ M.E in
Chemical/Biochemical/Biotechnology Engg./ Materials/ Nanotechnology or equivalent
degrees. Desirable: · Candidates having a valid CSIR/UGC-NET or GATE
scorecard. · Candidates having experience in Physical & Chemical analysis, AI
(coding) and instrumentation.
Fellowship a) Rs.35,000/- per months including HRA
b) Rs. 31000/- per month (availing hostel facility on paid basis).
For the candidate who possess valid CSIR / UGC-JRF / NET / GATE /Qualified National
Level Test conducted by Central Govt. Departments and their agencies (qualifying test for
Ph.D. entry along with Minimum qualification.
No. of posts 02 (two)
Tenure The initial offer will be for one year and renewable for up to two more years subject to
satisfactory performance. The position is Temporary and co-terminus with the project
(may be terminated anytime due to non-performance and withdrawal of the grant.
Age Preferably not more than 35 years as on closing date of Advertisement
Last date Last date to apply has been extended up to 30.06.2026 by 4.00 P.M. in PRESCRIBED
FORMAT ONLY (hard copy) as attached (page 4-6)
Professor Gaurav Verma
Director CIL/SAIF/UCIM/RSIC
Panjab University
Chandigarh
2
How to Apply: -
1. Interested candidates should send the application by post in the prescribed format (page 4-6) available
below this advertisement (convert into PDF Format) to the undersigned on (or) before the extended last
date i.e. 4.00 P.M. on 30.06.2026. Please mention the name of the Post in the Envelope.
Note: (Sending only resumes/CV by email will not be considered as complete application).
2. List of shortlisted candidates for further selection process will be notified through email only. Therefore,
please mention active Mobile Number and Email ID in the application form. (Tentative Interview date:
will be intimated later on)
3. Recent passport size photograph and photocopies of relevant certificates and other testimonials in support
of age, qualification, experience etc. will be collected at an appropriate stage.
4. The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information submitted / documents and
photograph. It is the responsibility of the candidate to assess his / her own eligibility to the post(s) for
which he / she is appearing in accordance to this advertisement. If it is detected at any time in future,
during the process of selection or even after appointment that the candidate was not eligible as per the
prescribed eligibility criteria in this advertisement, which could not be detected at the time of selection for
whatsoever reason, his/her candidature/appointment shall be liable to be cancelled/terminated
immediately.
5. GENERAL INFORMATION / DETAILS ABOUT THE POST:-
i. The appointment is purely temporary and will terminate automatically without any notice* or
compensation on termination of the research project/ *non-performance of the selected candidate.
ii. The appointed person shall have no claim of appointment / absorption in Funding Agency.
iii. Appointment of the applicant will be governed by the terms and conditions of the funding agency
particularly applicable to the said project.
iv. The qualification prescribed should have been obtained from recognized Universities / Institutions.
v. The prescribed educational qualifications are the bare minimum and mere possession of same does not
entitled candidates to be called for interview. Where number of applications received in response to this
advertisement is large, it will not be convenient or possible to interview all the candidates. Based on
the recommendations of the Screening Committee, the Principal Investigator may restrict the number
of candidates for the interview to a reasonable limit after taking into consideration the qualifications
and experience over and above the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. Therefore, it will be in
the interest of the candidates, to mention all the qualifications and experience in the relevant field at the
time of applying.
vi. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing for the interview.
vii. Selected candidates will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer.
viii. No interim enquiries/correspondence / communication of any sort will be entertained on the matter. But
if absolutely necessary candidates may post their queries on rsic@pu.ac.in only.
3
ix. Canvassing in any form and / or bringing any influence, political, or otherwise, will be treated as a
disqualification for the post applied for.
x. Candidates selected for this position can also apply for the regular PhD program of Panjab University
Chandigarh, provided they satisfy the eligibility criteria (www.puchd.ac.in).
(Professor Gaurav Verma),
Panjab University Chandigarh 160014
